copy.high: Anomalies at or above this threshold can be auto-resolved.
copy.low: Requires SME escalation or manual investigation.

copy.cycle: Active billing period for anomaly detection.
copy.sla: Time window for billing-run review completion.
copy.instance: Current working instance for operator sessions.

settings.label: Enable Pattern Grouping
settings.note: Off, 207 anomalies arrive ungrouped and the operator is back to individual investigation.

settings.label: Auto-Group Similar Anomalies
settings.note: Groups by shared root cause rather than by charge type.

settings.label: Pattern Preview Mode
settings.note: Shows candidate patterns before they are confirmed. Noisy — off by default.

settings.label: Enable Bulk Operations
settings.note: The Apply Fix to All path. Off, every correction is per-account.

settings.label: Allow Micro-Hold on Accounts
settings.note: Holds an individual account out of a bulk action without dropping it from the cycle.

settings.label: Require SME Approval for High Risk
settings.note: A second signature on the highest-consequence corrections.

settings.label: Continuous Learning Mode
settings.note: Feeds resolved anomalies back as labeled data between scheduled retrains.

settings.label: Capture Operator Corrections
settings.note: The 1,847 corrections behind the next retrain come from here.

settings.label: Track ML Error Patterns
settings.note: Records where the model was wrong, not only where it was right.
